Date: 2022-12-22
ABSTRACT OF THE DISCLOSURE
A pneumatic actuator can include a housing and an actuator shaft disposed within the housing and configured to actuate between a first position and a second position. The pneumatic actuator can include a single bushing located within the housing between the housing and the actuator shaft. The single bushing can be configured to support the actuator shaft without the actuator shaft being supported at a second location while allowing actuator motion under set operating conditions. 19 131152724v.1
